acceptance: Worker process trims on shutdown signal

subtasks.notes: CARMACK FIX APPLIED. Root cause (2.5GB leak per hung test process) addressed: (1) __enter__/__exit__ enables `with NativeGGUFProvider() as p:`, (2) shutdown() hardened with terminate()+kill() fallback + malloc_trim(0), (3) worker process trims on shutdown signal, (4) systemd unit omega-inference.service with MemoryMax=8G + Delegate=yes keeps worker in cgroup. All monitoring stack CUT per Carmack NO-GO.
